table.title: Description of the typical operating mode

row.entry: In the Active mode, the module is fully functional and data transmission is available, meanwhile, the module can be switched to either Idle or PSM mode.
In the Idle mode, the module is in the DRX or eDRX state, with a connected network and able to receive paging messages, meanwhile, the module can be switched to either Active or PSM mode.
In the PSM mode, the module is in the minimal power consumption state, with disconnected network and unable to receive the paging messages.
